summary: Frontend-only testing of the new RESULTS section and SEO meta tags on the static Squared Room site. All acceptance criteria PASS. Note: The frontend dev server was serving a stale default index.html (title 'Emergent | Fullstack App', lang='en', no OG tags). A `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` was required to pick up the updated public/index.html. After restart, all SEO tags and the entire page render correctly.

verified.results_section: Present with data-testid='results-section' and id='resultados'. Header 'EL TRABAJO SE VE, LOS NÚMEROS LO DEMUESTRAN' visible. Subheader 'RESULTADOS REALES' visible.
verified.stat_counters: All 4 counters (results-stat-0..3) render final animated values correctly: 120+, 8+, 50+, 95% with labels Atletas entrenados / Años de experiencia / Competiciones disputadas / Adherencia media.
verified.highlight_cards: All 3 cards (results-highlight-0..2) render an image + caption: HYROX PRO ('-9 min en el crono en 12 semanas'), COMPOSICIÓN CORPORAL ('+6 kg de masa muscular magra'), CROSSTRAINING ('Clasificación a competición nacional').
verified.seo_title: 'The Squared Room | Coaching de Entrenamiento Híbrido y Nutrición · Mettle Program' - PASS
verified.seo_meta_description: Contains 'coaching de entrenamiento híbrido y nutrición' - PASS
verified.seo_og_tags: og:title and og:image both present in DOM head - PASS
verified.regression: Page loads with 0 console errors. No [data-reveal] elements stuck at opacity 0 while in viewport (0 stuck / 1 in view at top; deeper reveals correctly hidden until scrolled).

action_items: None functional. Informational: If public/index.html is updated in future, restart frontend (sudo supervisorctl restart frontend) since CRA dev server can cache the served HTML shell.
critical_code_review_comments: ResultsSection CountUp uses IntersectionObserver with threshold 0.4 and once=true — works correctly on scroll into view.
index.html contains full SEO block (title, description, canonical, keywords, OG, Twitter, JSON-LD schema HealthAndBeautyBusiness) — well structured.
Static site, no backend — nothing else to review server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static React site. Only /app/frontend/public/index.html changes require `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` — component/JS changes hot-reload fine. Results section uses IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.4) — scroll into view and wait ~2s to observe final animated numbers.
